message: The published false-break rate is no longer zero: a finding classified `breaking` was adjudicated as something no correct client would notice. That is a classifier problem, not a reporting one. CI gates on every breaking finding *having* a verdict, never on what the verdict says, so this is invisible to the build by design. RC1-611. @webhook-incident-summarizer
name: API Compatibility Lab — a finding was adjudicated a false break
